messages.subject: GRM power analysis?
parts:
Hi!

I was wondering if there's a way to conduct power analysis for testing differences of graded response model parameters among groups to obtain an estimate of required sample size?
My study will have two independent variables, each with two levels - so, there are 4 groups - and I want to test how being in each of those 4 groups will affect GRM parameters.

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: GRM power analysis?
parts:
Monte Carlo simulation is likely your best bet; I don't think there is a closed-form solution to do this. Sorry.

Phil
